task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for EXT-05 at src/design/ext-05-sub-process-support.md. Define SUB_PROCESS node behavior from activation through completion/error propagation. Specify parent-child linkage model, parent WAITING token semantics, child start path reuse from EE-01, and variable handoff rules (copy-on-start, merge-on-child-complete via EE-09). Define event contracts for CHILD_PROCESS_ERROR and CHILD_PROCESS_CANCELLED with required payload fields including child instance_id and parent instance_id. Specify cancellation semantics: parent cancel does not cascade to child. Define how child definition snapshot stability is preserved when source definition changes after start. Map engine ordering constraints, persistence touchpoints, and error transitions to EE-10. Provide complete traceability matrix for EXT-05 acceptance criteria and edge cases plus required unit/integration tests. Design only; do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Design fully maps all EXT-05 acceptance criteria and edge cases to concrete behavior
Parent WAITING semantics and child lifecycle propagation are explicit and testable
Variable copy-on-start and merge-on-complete contract is precisely defined
Error and cancellation event contracts include exact payload expectations
Traceability matrix identifies implementation modules and verification hooks

result.summary: Design artefact for EXT-05 completed at src/design/ext-05-sub-process-support.md, defining SUB_PROCESS parent-child lifecycle from activation to completion/error propagation with explicit WAITING token semantics, child-start reuse of EE-01, copy-on-start and EE-09 merge-on-complete variable contracts, exact CHILD_PROCESS_ERROR and CHILD_PROCESS_CANCELLED payload requirements (including parent_instance_id and child_instance_id), non-cascading parent cancel behavior, child snapshot stability, ordering constraints, persistence touchpoints, EE-10 mappings, and full traceability to acceptance criteria and edge-case tests.
